props.name: slot
props.meaning: The `data-slot` prefix every part of this picker carries.

props.name: picker
props.meaning: The `data-picker` the popup carries.

props.name: multiple
props.meaning: Several keys may be chosen at once.

props.name: keys
props.meaning: The chosen keys, in order. A single picker passes none or one.

props.name: on_select
props.meaning: The keys the primitive settled on. The load-more row never reaches it.

props.name: labels
props.meaning: One label per chosen key. The summary, the title and the measured row read it.

props.name: items
props.meaning: React: the item keys the list offers, in order.

props.name: chips_slot
props.meaning: The `data-slot` of the chip row.

props.name: summary
props.meaning: What the control shows for the selection.

props.name: max
props.meaning: Chips drawn before the rest becomes `+n`. `0` fits what the row can.

props.name: chip_row
props.meaning: The value is a measured row of chips rather than one chip.

props.name: inline
props.meaning: The control holds the caret. A summary control keeps it in the popup.

props.name: token_input
props.meaning: The caret gives its room to the chips.

props.name: input_placeholder
props.meaning: What the caret shows.

props.name: searchable
props.meaning: A summary control keeps a search row. A fixed set has nothing to search.

props.name: text_value
props.meaning: The filled value is plain text, so the control keeps the reading inset in both states.

props.name: row_key
props.meaning: What the chips look like, so a change re-measures the row.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Control height: 7, 8 and 9.

props.name: inert
props.meaning: The primitive takes no input. Wider than disabled: a loading picker is inert too.

props.name: clearable
props.meaning: The clear control is drawn once something is chosen.

props.name: open
props.meaning: Whether the popup is showing. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: query
props.meaning: What the caret holds. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: on_query_change
props.meaning: React: called when the caret changes.

props.name: on_remove_at
props.meaning: Remove the chip at `index`. Backspace walks the row through it.

props.name: anchored
props.meaning: The popup is as wide as the control it hangs off.

props.name: loading
props.meaning: Skeleton rows in place of the list.

props.name: error
props.meaning: The error line in place of the list.

props.name: empty
props.meaning: The empty line in place of the list.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: The accessible name of the skeletons.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of the failed read's own message.

props.name: has_more
props.meaning: A further page is there to be read, and the load-more row is drawn.

props.name: on_load_more
props.meaning: Called by a press on the load-more row.

props.name: overflow_label
props.meaning: The accessible name of the `+n` pill.

props.name: item_to_string_label
props.meaning: React: what the primitive writes into the input for an item.

props.name: control_props
props.meaning: Attributes the control carries on top of the shared ones.

slots.name: chip
slots.receives: the chip's index, whether the caret is on it, whether the row hides it
slots.draws: One chip of the value. The chip under the caret wears the focus ring; a hidden one keeps its width.

slots.name: rows
slots.receives: nothing in Svelte, the item key in React
slots.draws: The rows of the list, as items of the primitive.

keyboard.does: Moves the highlight, and the list scrolls it into view.
Takes the highlighted row. A multi picker keeps the popup open.
Closes the popup and clears the query. On a closed picker it does nothing.
In an empty query: takes the caret to the last chip of a multi picker; clears a single one.
On a chip, walks the row. `ArrowRight` past the last chip returns to the input.
On a chip, removes it and leaves the caret on its neighbour.
